mechanism: Tazarotene is a potent teratogen that significantly increases risk of birth defects; levonorgestrel contraceptive efficacy may be reduced by tazarotene-induced hepatic enzyme activity or enterohepatic recirculation disruption.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if tazarotene is necessary, use additional non-hormonal contraception and ensure reliable pregnancy prevention given severe teratogenic risk to any developing fetus.
